message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians can enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, or one that is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Long‑weekend span (Saturday – Monday) | Notes |
|---------|--------------|---------------------------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) – observed Mon 2 | **Jan 1 – 2** | The holiday is observed on Monday, giving a 2‑day weekend. |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | Feb 20 (Monday) | **Feb 18 – 20** | Third Monday in February. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | **Apr 7 – 9** | Friday + weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | **May 20 – 22** | First Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) – observed Mon 3 | **Jul 1 – 3** | Observed on Monday when it falls on a weekend. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | **Sep 2 – 4** | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | **Oct 7 – 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | **Dec 23 – 25** | Observed on Monday. |

### Provincial/territorial holidays that also create long weekends

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date in 2023 | Long‑weekend span |
|--------------------|---------|--------------|-------------------|
| New Brunswick | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | **Mar 15 – 17** |
| Manitoba | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |
| Saskatchewan | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |
| British Columbia | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Saturday) – observed Mon 26 | **Jun 24 – 26** |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |
| Yukon | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |
| Northwest Territories | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |
| Nunavut | St. George’s Day | Jun 23 (Friday) | **Jun 21 – 23** |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you’re building a holiday‑planning feature, consider flagging each holiday with its “observed” date (e.g., Canada Day on July 3) and automatically extending the weekend span to include the adjacent Saturday and Monday. This will give users a clear view of all possible long‑weekend trips for 2023.
